patterns: Almost all PYQs are MPPSC section-number recall: PoA Sec 14 Special Court, Sec 18 anticipatory bail, Sec 6 IPC application, Rule 17 district committee, PCR Sec 5/12/14
APPSC itself asks: PCR Act extends to whole of India, and the case alleged to have diluted the Act (Subhash Kashinath Mahajan)
Recurring facts: PoA in force 30 Jan 1990, 23 sections, DSP-rank investigator, Special Court with concurrence of HC Chief Justice, rule-making by Centre, collective fine by State Govt
App MCQs are heavier on 2015/2018 amendments, case chronology and current NCRB/AP data; light on the bare section-number recall that dominates PYQs
Trap: Sec 18 vs 18A; PCR Sec 12 presumption applies to SCs only
